text:
rachel: Putting together a short follow-up thread from the DR postmortem. Goal: assign owners for cross-region game-day tasks, backup validation automation, and the routing cooling lock. Please ACK below with due_ts.

rachel: Main action buckets I noted: 1) cross-region restore runbook updates (table-level + CMK notes), 2) automated backup-validator that does checksum diffs and emits metrics, 3) routing cooling lock + canary sequence, 4) game-day comms + run-through checklist.

omar: I'll take the runbook edits. I'll add clear pre-checks (stop-writes, replication lag check < 5s), explicit promote steps for replicas, and CMK rotate caveats. ETA: 1825060000. Example snippet I'll add: ```
# check replication lag
SELECT now()-pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp();
```

viv: I'll own the backup-validator. Plan: monthly dry-restore of critical tables to read-only namespace, run checksum diffs, emit Prom metric `backup_validation_failures_total`, store artifact in s3://redwood-validate/dr/. ETA: 1825035000. Will include a scrub stage per security.

infra-bot: job_status backup-dry-restore last_run=1824990000 status=success artifacts=/artifacts/backup-1824990000.tgz

rachel: @viv please ensure alerts fire to #incidents and create an oncall playbook entry for triage.

viv: Will do. Also adding a quick smoke test: `curl -sf https://api.eu.redwood.internal/health || exit 1` after restore.

omar: For runbook I'll include a "pre-switchover" checklist with commands and expected timing windows and mark any manual approvals.

sec-bot: Reminder: any snapshots used in dry-restores must be scrubbed of PII. Submit scrub script in PR for security review; we'll approve scoped creds for the pipeline after review.

product: Product ops asked for target RTOs: read-only restore <= 15m, full writable <= 60m. Can owners confirm feasibility during dry-run?

omar: I'll time the promote steps during a staging run and report numbers. If full writable restore can't meet 60m we'll propose tiered plan.

viv: I'll measure restore duration and surface `dr_restore_duration_seconds` in Prom. If > 3600s we alert.

rachel: Routing: we need a cooling lock to prevent back-to-back failovers and a canary sequence. Who wants routing ownership?

omar: I can draft the routing steps but prefer infra to own BGP config. I'll document DNS TTLs and weighted canary percentages.

viv: Suggest TTLs: internal endpoints 20s, public frontends 60s. Canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 90s observation windows and a 10-minute cooling lock.

infra-bot: scheduled_job reminder: backup-validator next_run=1825038600

infra-bot: note: recent incident patterns show region flapping correlated with sudden traffic spikes. Recommend pre-failover capacity gating: target_cpu < 70% AND free_gpu_slots >= 2.

omar: I'll add the capacity gating and a simple health check script: ```
for i in 1..5; do curl -sf https://api.eu.redwood.internal/health || exit 1; done
```

product: I'll own comms templates and the incident role assignments during game-day. Need a short status page template and three notification tiers (internal, customer-impact, executive).

rachel: Great. I've created a single tracker row per item: https://redwood.internal/incidents/cross-region-game-day-2026. Please comment on your row to ACK and set due_ts. I'll mark rows "in progress" when PRs are open.

omar: ACK "runbook edits + CMK notes" assigned. due_ts=1825060000

viv: ACK "backup-validator + scrub stage" assigned. due_ts=1825035000

product: ACK "game-day comms + templates" assigned. due_ts=1825050000

sec-bot: We'll prioritize scrub review once PRs include sample masking. Also recommend MFA-delete on artifact bucket and 90d retention for validation artifacts.

rachel: Proposed mini game-day: 2-hour rehearsal 1825120000. Volunteers: DB (omar), backups (viv), routing (infra), comms (product). Please confirm availability.

omar: I'll run DB restore and time RTO.

viv: I'll execute the dry-restore and present validation results.

product: I'll run comms and update status page.

rachel: If anyone hits permission blockers for KMS or S3 access ping @sec-bot and #eng-infra. Closing for now; will reopen if owners change. :white_check_mark:
